note: City of Clear Lake park on a wooded point on the east shore of Clear Lake (18121 Memorial Dr.), with a boat dock, fishing dock, disc golf, playground and a nature trail. The nearest dump station is in town, south of the City Park. --Claude
summary: City parks page: 24 sites (10 W/E, 14 FHU 50/30/20), $25 W/E / $30 FHU ($20 tent), FCFS, showers, wifi, check-out 4 pm; dump only in town. Fees/hookups/sites/booking confirmed (now manual), wifi added. WATERFRONT LEAD: stored lakefront not supported - recommend lakeview. max_rig_ft 40 has no source. Phone/website confirmed. Note rewritten.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE LEAD (lakefront -> lakeview): the stored evidence ('RV sites ... on open grass apron running to Clear Lake shoreline at SW point with dock') describes the dock point at 44.7553,-96.6572, which on Esri is a gravel turnaround serving the boat/fishing dock - day use, with no pads or pedestals visible. The only RVs visible (USGS NAIP frame) are along the inland (east) side of the NW shore road around 44.7575,-96.6565, ~45-70 m from the water with the campground road and a continuous shoreline tree band between. Picnic tables/fire rings also sit on the lake side of that road behind the same tree fringe. No city page, photo or listing names lakeshore sites. Under 'unsure after every source -> down' and the own-loop-road rule, lakeview is the call (open views through the tree fringe; not on-water). Not an --AWH value. Replacement evidence: 'Esri + USGS NAIP 2026-11-22: RVs on the inland side of the NW shore road ~45-70 m from Clear Lake behind the road and a shoreline tree band; the open apron at the SW point is the dock turnaround (day use) -> lakeview'.
